description: HOLDEXT: EXTRACT THE DAY'S HOLDS FOR POSTING
AT THE END OF THE ONLINE DAY, READS THE HOLDS IN KEY ORDER,
WHICH IS ACCOUNT ORDER, AND WRITES THE CARD FILE FOR THE
NIGHT'S BATCH IN THE FORM OF THE DAILY TRANSACTION FILE: A
HEADER FROM THE CARDS FOR THE BUSINESS DATE, A DETAIL FOR
EVERY CARD PURCHASE AND ATM WITHDRAWAL STILL HELD, ANOTHER
FOR THE FEE OF A WITHDRAWAL THAT HAD ONE, AND A TRAILER WITH
THE CONTROL TOTALS. REVERSED PURCHASES ARE LEFT OUT.
TRANSACTION IDS ARE 9, THE HOLD NUMBER, 00, AND 1 FOR THE
RETURN CODES: 0 EXTRACTED, 16 A HOLD OF ANOTHER DAY OR I/O.

identification.text: FIRST BANK OF PANGAEA, DATA CENTER.

records.name: BANK-CONTROL-RECORD
records.description: BANKCTL: BANK CONTROL RECORD, ONE PER FILE THE BUSINESS DATE THE BATCH RUNS FOR, NEVER THE CLOCK.

records.name: HOLD-RECORD
records.description: HOLDREC: HOLD RECORD, 100 BYTES AN AMOUNT AUTHORIZED ONLINE AND NOT YET POSTED: A CARD PURCHASE OR AN ATM WITHDRAWAL AND ITS FEE. INDEXED BY ACCOUNT AND HOLD NUMBER, THE AUTHORIZATION CODE, WHICH NUMBERS THE DAY'S HOLDS FROM 1. A REVERSED PURCHASE STAYS, MARKED. MODIFICATION HISTORY DATE       BY  CHANGE 2003-05-19 MV  CR-0342 ORIGINAL VERSION. 2007-02-05 MV  CR-0415 ATM FEE.

records.name: TRAN-RECORD
records.description: TRANREC: DAILY TRANSACTION FILE RECORD, 80 BYTES ONE HEADER, THE DETAILS, ONE TRAILER, TOLD APART BY THE RECORD TYPE. THE BODY IS REDEFINED FOR EACH RECORD TYPE. THE TRAILER CARRIES THE SENDER'S CONTROL TOTALS: THE DETAIL COUNT, THE SUM OF AMOUNTS AND THE SUM OF ACCOUNT NUMBERS. A TRANSFER (TR) NAMES THE ACCOUNT IT GOES TO. POSTING SPLITS IT IN TWO: THE DEBIT ON THE SENDING ACCOUNT, THEN A TRANSFER CREDIT (TC) ON THE RECEIVING ONE. A CREDIT THAT CANNOT POST GOES BACK AS A RETURNED TRANSFER (RT). TC AND RT ARE MADE BY POSTING, NEVER RECEIVED IN THE DAILY FILE. WHEN A MONTH CLOSES, THE BANK CREDITS ITS INTEREST (IN), CHARGES OVERDRAFT INTEREST (OD) AND THE MAINTENANCE FEE (MF). THESE TOO ARE NEVER RECEIVED IN THE DAILY FILE. THE CARD FILE, FROM THE ONLINE DAY'S HOLDS, HAS THE SAME FORM AND ITS OWN SOURCE: CARD PURCHASES (CP), ATM WITHDRAWALS (AW) AND ATM FEES (AF), WHICH WERE AUTHORIZED WHEN THEY WERE MADE. MODIFICATION HISTORY DATE       BY  CHANGE 1987-03-12 JA  ORIGINAL VERSION. 1991-06-03 PK  CR-0117 ACCOUNT NUMBER HASH IN THE TRAILER. 1996-04-15 PK  CR-0233 TRANSFERS: COUNTER ACCOUNT, FROM THE FILLER. 2001-09-03 TL  CR-0298 MONTH-END INTEREST AND FEE CODES. 2003-05-19 MV  CR-0342 THE CARD FILE AND ITS CODES.

paragraphs.name: 0000-MAIN
paragraphs.description: WRITE THE HEADER, A DETAIL OR TWO PER HOLD, AND THE TRAILER.

paragraphs.name: 1000-INITIALIZE
paragraphs.description: OPEN THE FILES, WRITE THE HEADER AND READ THE FIRST HOLD.

paragraphs.name: 2000-EXTRACT-HOLD
paragraphs.description: WRITE A HOLD STILL OPEN AS A TRANSACTION, AND ITS FEE AS ANOTHER. EVERY HOLD MUST BE OF THE BUSINESS DAY.

paragraphs.name: 2900-WRITE-DETAIL
paragraphs.description: WRITE A DETAIL AND ADD IT TO THE CONTROL TOTALS.

paragraphs.name: 9900-ABORT
paragraphs.description: STOP THE RUN WITH RETURN CODE 16, SAYING WHY.
